why: From A to B the two halves swap sides: the 3-arm half moves to the left and the 2-arm half moves to the right. While moving, the top arm of the 2-arm half turns over, and the lower two arms of the 3-arm half turn over. Doing the same to C gives a left half with arms cup, hump, cup and a right half with hump, cup, which is option 3. Option 2 has the correct left half but its right half did not change.
trick: Break each figure into its two halves and compare the small curves one by one; only one or two curves usually change.
note: Each curved arm is drawn as a simple cup or hump; the exact curve shapes in the scan are small and hard to read.
